message.content:
Below is everything you’ll need to send your “IP = malicious” vote to VirusTotal’s v3 API.  
(Replace **`<YOUR_KEY_FOUR>`** with the real API‑Key value you received.)

---

### 1️⃣ Endpoint & HTTP method  

```
POST   https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes
```

> *Why this URL?*  
> - `ip_addresses/<address>/votes` – the official route for submitting a verdict on a specific IP.  
> - The `<address>` part (`22.242.75.136`) identifies the target.

---

### 2️⃣ Required headers  

| Header                | Value |
|-----------------------|-------|
| `x-apikey`            | `<YOUR_KEY_FOUR>` |
| `Content-Type`        | `application/json` |

> The `x-apikey` header authenticates you. No other auth mechanism is needed.

---

### 3️⃣ Request body (JSON)

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": null,
    "type": "vote",
    "attributes": {
      "verdict": "malicious"
    }
  }
}
```

#### Notes on the payload

| Field          | Meaning                                   |
|----------------|-------------------------------------------|
| `"id"`         | Must be omitted / set to `null`.           |
| `"type"`       | Always `"vote"` when creating a new vote. |
| `"verdict"`    | One of: `"benign"`, `"suspicious"`, `"harmless"`, `"malicious"`. Here we use `"malicious"`. |

If you prefer a raw curl snippet:

```bash
curl --request POST \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes \
     --header 'x-apikey: <YOUR_KEY_FOUR>' \
     --header 'content-type: application/json' \
     --data '{"data":{"id":null,"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}}'
```

---

### 4️⃣ Expected response

A successful vote returns status **201 Created**, e.g.:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "<unique-vote-id>",
    "type": "vote",
    "links": { /* … */ },
    "attributes": {
      "created_at": "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ",
      "updated_at": "...",
      "verdict": "malicious",
      "confidence_level": 0.9,
      ...
    }
  }
}
```

If something goes wrong you'll see a standard error object explaining what failed (e.g., missing permission, invalid key, etc.).

---

### 5️⃣ Things to double‑check before sending

| Checkpoint                                 | Why it matters                                      |
|--------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| Key has **“Vote”** scope                    | Without the right permissions the API will reject. |
| Rate limits                               | You’re limited to X votes per minute/hour/day.      |
| Correct IP formatting                      | Leading zeros or spaces break the lookup.           |
| Network connectivity                       | Ensure outbound HTTPS traffic isn’t blocked.        |

---

That’s all! Once you hit the endpoint with those headers/body values, VirusTotal will register your “malicious” vote for `22.242.75.136`. If you run into errors, let me know the exact status code/message so I can help troubleshoot further.
